source.title: Dog Emotion

source.description: Images collected from various online sources and manually annotated by uploader; source URLs and per-image rights are not listed.

annotation_audit.label_method: Manual annotation by uploader, according to dataset record; no detailed protocol/adjudication published.

image_audit.visual_spot_check: 16-image contact sheet; varied breeds, poses, scenes, lighting, and image scale.

duplicate_audit.perceptual_hash_method: DCT pHash, 64-bit; candidate if Hamming distance <= 4
duplicate_audit.interpretation: Perceptual-hash candidates are not all visually confirmed duplicates.

license_verdict.current_hold_reason: User instructed not to train yet; uploader's authority over source images is not independently established.
